title: Tag group
summary: A row of tags: 4 apart, a list to a screen reader, one Tab stop with arrows and Delete, one line with «+N» that opens the hidden tags in a popover, and single or multiple choice for filter tags.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

layout.description: row: one line -- filters, a table cell, a card: the tags that do not fit leave it and «+N» opens them in a popover (C58, C145 (5)); wrap: the row wraps, every tag in view (a form)

selection.description: For filter tags (kind checkbox): none leaves each tag its own; one keeps a single tag chosen (choosing one clears the others; it can be cleared); many lets each be chosen. With one or many the group reports select

sf-tag-group-select.summary: A person chose or cleared a filter tag of the row (selection one or many): ids is the whole selection, id the tag pressed and selected whether it is now chosen (vocabulary §5 select)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: removing a tag (the page removes the element on sf-tag-close)

keyboard: Tab reaches the row once; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight walk the tags and «+N», Home and End go to the ends
Delete or Backspace removes the removable tag stood on; the focus goes to its neighbour
Enter or Space on «+N» opens the hidden tags; Escape closes them
accessibility.focus: One tag of the row is in the Tab order at a time: the one last stood on.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tag-group for any row of tags: chosen values to remove, filter chips above a list, a table cell's tags, an article's tag links.
do_not: Do not write the row's gap, «+N» or keys by hand; the group owns them
Do not use it for buttons (sf-button-group) or a 2-5 option switch (sf-segmented)
Do not remove a tag in the group yourself before sf-tag-close: the cross and Delete ask, the page removes
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-tag-group aria-label="Города"><sf-tag kind="default" closable text="Москва"></sf-tag><sf-tag kind="default" closable text="Казань"></sf-tag></sf-tag-group>
